fact.en: A mixture is a combination of two or more substances that are put together but not chemically joined.
fact.tl: Ang mixture ay kombinasyon ng dalawa o higit pang substances na pinagsama pero hindi chemically joined.
fact.bis: Ang mixture usa ka kombinasyon sa duha o daghan pa nga mga substances nga gisagol apan dili chemically joined.

cards.illustration: A clear glass bowl holding a colorful mix of small pebbles, sand, and water, showing different substances combined together.

fact.en:
Why does a glass of alcohol look the same everywhere?

Because alcohol is a homogeneous mixture, meaning it appears uniform all throughout and has the same proportion of components.
fact.tl:
Bakit pareho ang itsura ng alcohol sa buong baso?

Dahil ang alcohol ay homogeneous mixture, ibig sabihin uniform ang itsura nito sa lahat ng bahagi at pareho ang proportion ng mga components.
fact.bis:
Ngano pareho man ang hitsura sa tibuok baso sa alcohol?

Tungod kay ang alcohol usa ka homogeneous mixture, nagpasabot nga uniform ang hitsura sa tibuok ug pareho ang proportion sa mga components.

cards.illustration: A clear glass of rubbing alcohol on a table, looking perfectly clear and the same from top to bottom.

fact.en: A heterogeneous mixture is not uniform, so the combined substances are not evenly spread and you can often see or identify the different parts.
fact.tl: Ang heterogeneous mixture ay hindi uniform, kaya hindi pantay ang pagkakasama ng mga substances at madalas nakikita o nakikilala mo ang iba't ibang bahagi nito.
fact.bis: Ang heterogeneous mixture dili uniform, mao nga dili parehas ang pagkakasagol sa mga substances ug sagad makita o mailhan nimo ang lain-laing mga parte.

cards.illustration: A bowl of vegetable salad with separate pieces of lettuce, tomatoes, and cucumber clearly visible and not mixed evenly.

fact.en: Air is a homogeneous mixture because its gases are evenly spread, so it looks the same everywhere around you.
fact.tl: Ang hangin ay homogeneous mixture dahil pantay ang pagkakalat ng mga gas nito, kaya pareho ang itsura nito saan ka man tumingin.
fact.bis: Ang hangin usa ka homogeneous mixture tungod kay parehas ang pagkaylap sa mga gas, mao nga pareho ang hitsura bisan asa ka motan-aw.

cards.illustration: A child standing outside looking at the clear sky and trees, with invisible air all around them.

fact.en:
Why is pizza a heterogeneous mixture?

Because you can easily see and identify its different parts like the crust, cheese, sauce, and toppings, and they are not evenly spread.
fact.tl:
Bakit heterogeneous mixture ang pizza?

Dahil madali mong makita at makilala ang iba't ibang bahagi nito tulad ng crust, cheese, sauce, at toppings, at hindi pantay ang pagkakalat ng mga ito.
fact.bis:
Ngano heterogeneous mixture man ang pizza?

Tungod kay dali nimo makita ug mailhan ang lain-laing mga parte sama sa crust, cheese, sauce, ug toppings, ug dili parehas ang pagkaylap sa mga kini.

cards.illustration: A single slice of pizza with separate toppings of cheese, pepperoni, and green pepper clearly visible on top.

fact.en: Tea with sugar is a homogeneous mixture because the sugar dissolves and spreads evenly, making the drink look the same throughout.
fact.tl: Ang tsaa na may asukal ay homogeneous mixture dahil natutunaw ang asukal at pantay na kumakalat, kaya pareho ang itsura ng inumin sa buong baso.
fact.bis: Ang tsa nga may asukar usa ka homogeneous mixture tungod kay matunaw ang asukar ug parehas nga mokaylap, mao nga pareho ang hitsura sa ilimnon sa tibuok baso.

cards.illustration: A clear glass of iced tea with a spoon resting inside, looking the same color from top to bottom.

fact.en: Pinakbet is a heterogeneous mixture because you can still see and identify the separate vegetables like squash, string beans, and eggplant.
fact.tl: Ang pinakbet ay heterogeneous mixture dahil nakikita at nakikilala mo pa rin ang magkakahiwalay na gulay tulad ng kalabasa, sitaw, at talong.
fact.bis: Ang pinakbet usa ka heterogeneous mixture tungod kay makita ug mailhan pa nimo ang bulag nga mga utanon sama sa kalabasa, sitaw, ug talong.

cards.illustration: A bowl of pinakbet showing separate pieces of squash, string beans, and eggplant in a savory broth.

fact.en:
Why does 3 in 1 coffee look different before and after adding hot water?

Before, it is a heterogeneous mixture of coffee, sugar, and cream powder you can see. After dissolving in hot water, it becomes a homogeneous mixture that looks uniform.
fact.tl:
Bakit iba ang itsura ng 3 in 1 coffee bago at pagkatapos lagyan ng mainit na tubig?

Bago, ito ay heterogeneous mixture ng kape, asukal, at cream powder na nakikita mo. Pagkatapos matunaw sa mainit na tubig, nagiging homogeneous mixture ito na uniform ang itsura.
fact.bis:
Ngano lahi man ang hitsura sa 3 in 1 coffee sa wala pa ug human butangi ug init nga tubig?

Sa wala pa, kini usa ka heterogeneous mixture sa kape, asukar, ug cream powder nga imong makita. Human matunaw sa init nga tubig, mahimo kini nga homogeneous mixture nga uniform ang hitsura.

cards.illustration: A sachet of 3 in 1 coffee powder next to a steaming cup of dissolved coffee that looks uniform brown.

fact.en: A vegetable salad is a heterogeneous mixture because the combined ingredients are not evenly spread and each vegetable stays easy to see and identify.
fact.tl: Ang vegetable salad ay heterogeneous mixture dahil hindi pantay ang pagkakasama ng mga sangkap at bawat gulay ay madaling makita at makilala.
fact.bis: Ang vegetable salad usa ka heterogeneous mixture tungod kay dili parehas ang pagkakasagol sa mga sangkap ug ang matag utanon dali nga makita ug mailhan.

cards.illustration: A bowl of fresh vegetable salad with separate pieces of carrots, cucumber, and lettuce clearly visible.

fact.en:
What are the two kinds of mixtures?

Mixtures can be homogeneous, which look uniform all throughout, or heterogeneous, which are not uniform and often show their different parts.
fact.tl:
Ano ang dalawang uri ng mixtures?

Ang mixtures ay maaaring homogeneous, na uniform ang itsura sa lahat ng bahagi, o heterogeneous, na hindi uniform at madalas nakikita ang iba't ibang bahagi.
fact.bis:
Unsa ang duha ka klase sa mixtures?

Ang mixtures mahimong homogeneous, nga uniform ang hitsura sa tibuok, o heterogeneous, nga dili uniform ug sagad makita ang lain-laing mga parte.

cards.illustration: Two glasses side by side: one with clear uniform liquid and one with visible separate chunks of fruit in water.
